title: Decode: DSA attention path (q path, sparse MLA, DCP value, indexer)
shape: D3-32 r24 1-node DP-rank slice, NVFP4 ckpt (k31-nvfp4-view-L24: 6 DSA layers), 384 verify rows/rank, u132k, k=3; family = DSA q path + sparse MLA + DCP value + prologue + indexer logits, in-step exposed

gap_analysis: After LocalQuery (r24, us per DSA layer exposed): q path 16 (ach 22: model charges the P6 publish), sparse MLA 33 (ach 9.7), DcpValue 25 (ach 9.7), prologue 5, indexer logits 24 (ach 17.7). Remaining gap is sparse MLA + DcpValue + indexer. Sparse MLA SOL design: every SM must receive each gathered KV row once (384 rows x ~512 local keys x 576 B = 113 MB/layer); measured per-SM TMA gather4 receive ~25-35 B/clk -> ~8-11 us; MMA in the keys-on-M form (S^T = K Q^T with N = 96 real heads, O^T 4 x 96 TMEM cols, A = K/V^T from the gathered tile, B = Q^T/P^T) is smem-operand-fetch bound at ~238 KB per 128 keys -> ~6.6 us, overlappable -> projected ~10-12 us vs 9.7 model (the model has no per-row gather term; P-MLA measured the same floor). v1 (V-split pair) measured 49.5 us at R384 standalone vs trtllm-gen 40.6: bound by 2x SM-side receive (both CTAs need all 576 B of each row). Indexer: joint 4-row M128 MMA, keys streamed once per request. DcpValue: W_UV + push in one kernel.
inefficiencies: Sparse MLA trtllm-gen: ~20 us fixed + 0.055 us/row, 128 padded heads (measured standalone 40.6 us at R384)
Native v1 V-split pair: 2x SM receive bytes (each CTA needs full rows for QK) -> replaced by keys-on-M
DcpValue proj: 25 us/layer vs ~9.7 model (W_UV bmm of all gathered heads + push + LSE merge)
Indexer logits: DeepGEMM paged logits streams keys per verify row (24 us/layer vs 17.7)
LocalQuery GEMMs: cuBLAS q_b 96 heads + W_UK bmm ~16 us/layer (below the model q path; fusable later)
rubin_features: tcgen05 UMMA (FP8 / block-scaled MXFP4) with TMEM accumulators
TMA gather4 for paged KV / index-key row gathers
